ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of low-intensity (black/charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks along the entire trailing edge; extreme structural protrusions (50+ pixel deviations) at both distal tips due to epibiotic clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe, cutting across the light-mottled background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on both lateral tips and along sections of the trailing edge, creating a rough, calcified topography; numerous circular white scars present on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips are thickened and distorted by massive, bulbous barnacle clusters, creating a unique, asymmetrical silhouette on the distal edges.
